comments.body: The source locations in this module doc need precise citations in the required backticked `file.c:LINE` form. This one is wrong: the `curr` range check is `decompress.c:323-333`, not lines 337-347. The min/max scan cited at line 16 is `decompress.c:337-352`, not 359-364, and the assignment range at line 14 must include the doubling at `huffman.c:164`. Please correct those and give the other C claims here exact citations (for example alpha size at `decompress.c:282-284`, table construction at `huffman.c:170-200`, the decode loop at `decompress.c:74-102`, and input starvation at `decompress.c:43-65`).

`bsW` does not mask its value to `n` bits: `compress.c:73-77` ORs the full shifted value into the pending buffer. For the example table `[1, 1, 1]`, `bsW(1, 0)` followed by `bsW(1, 2)` leaves high bits `10`, changing the previous bit; it does not emit independent low-bit codewords `00`. Please describe `codeword` as a low-bit representation of the assigned integer and remove the claim that it models what the C writer sends for over-subscribed codes, including the docstring at line 87.
